lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Let's go through last week's goals. Mine first: meetpipe now pulls GitHub PRs, commits, Drive docs and Claude Code logs into a brief. Gmail transcripts work too. I still need to merge my branch into main.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Slack works end to end. The bot can post in test-bot-features and DM all three of us, with file attachments.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: The After agent is merged. It takes a transcript, summarizes it, splits human and agent tasks, and queues the agent ones for approval. It's only been tested on a canned demo though, the Claude key came in today.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: I looked at options. Recall.ai has a bot that joins Meet or Zoom, and meeting captions are free. I want to go with that.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Decision then: Recall.ai for live transcripts. Second decision, After sends its Slack messages through Michael's send_message instead of its own client.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: Agreed, I'll switch it over today.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: I'll add a slash command so people can approve agent tasks from Slack, should be done by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: I'll merge the meetpipe branch into main and write brief.json in a format After can read, by Monday.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: I'll integrate the Recall bot by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Someone also needs to record the demo video for submission. We'll figure out who.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Open question: do we store transcripts after processing, or delete them for privacy?

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Let's think about it. Meeting agent, schedule our next sync Thursday at 3pm for 30 minutes with all of us.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: And generate a one-page visual report of this meeting we can show the judges.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Also we need snacks for demo night, can the agent find a way to order some?

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Sure, but nothing gets bought without approval. Thanks everyone.
